remarks:
LOOKING FOR FIRST-FLOOR LIVING, A 2-CAR GARAGE AND A FENCED YARD? 44 Wing Ct brings them together in a 3-bedroom Cape Cod tucked away on a neighborhood cul-de-sac in the Maryvale School District! With two first-floor bedrooms, a full bath, full basement and detached 2-car garage, this home offers a flexible layout with plenty of opportunity to make it your own.

Step inside to a comfortable floor plan featuring a living room and an eat-in country kitchen with plenty of room to gather for everyday meals. The kitchen includes a dishwasher and microwave. Two bedrooms are conveniently located on the first floor along with the full bath, while the second floor provides an additional bedroom that could also work well as a home office, hobby room or private guest space.

Hardwood flooring in portions of the home adds character, while the full basement provides valuable additional storage and includes the laundry area. Forced-air gas heat, public water and connected sewer service add to the home's everyday convenience.

Outside, the fully fenced yard gives you your own space to relax, entertain, garden or enjoy the outdoors. A deck and open porch provide additional places to enjoy the warmer Western New York months. The detached 2-car garage offers excellent space for vehicles, tools, lawn equipment and additional storage, while the concrete driveway provides convenient off-street parking.

Conveniently located near shopping, dining and everyday necessities, this home presents an exciting opportunity for a buyer ready to add their own style and updates.

Bring your ideas and imagine the possibilities at 44 Wing Ct! This is an estate and is being sold as-is. Don't miss your opportunity to see what this Cheektowaga Cape Cod has to offer!
